text:
Sam (partnerships): Quick heads-up — ACMECloud wants us on their EU Gov marketplace by May 10. They require the latest SOC2, a 3rd-party firmware pen test for our edge gateway integration, and SI attestation. Can ops/security owners weigh in on evidence and timeline?
Toni (security): Thanks. Is the firmware pen test scoped to our binary only or full supply chain? we need to clarify. Also will ACME accept a redacted pen report + signed attestation?
Sam (partnerships): Good Q. ACME said "firmware + bootloader" and supply-chain notes. They accept a redacted pen test PDF + SSO'd presigned artifacts for reviewers.
Elena (SI): For SI attestation we need an OEM letter for HSM usage and proof of key management. I can push the templates to the partner if someone confirms contact.
Raj (eng-infra): From infra side: we can generate presigned uploads to the secure bucket. ETA for presign workflow is ~48h once we have the artifact list. Example presign CLI: `aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/firmware-v1.bin --expires-in 604800`
Mira (compliance): SOC2 is current (March 2026). I'll prepare a SOC2 extract + statement of scope page. For pen-test we need: scope doc, test report, remediation attestation (if fixes), and contact for test witness. Who owns redaction?
Toni (security): Security will own pen-test redaction. We'll remove PII and escalate vulnerabilities above severity 3. We need a copy of the test plan from the vendor to confirm accepted methodology (SANS/OWASP/CREST).
Sam (partnerships): I'll get vendor test plan and partner contact. Timeline request from ACME: submit artifacts by Apr 28 to make May 10 listing.
Elena (SI): SI team can produce the attestation letter once OEM sign-off is in. Need OEM point of contact. @Sam can you share?
Sam (partnerships): Sharing now: acme-contact@acmecloud.example (DMed). Also adding the OEM lead: firmware-ops@edgevendor.example.
Raj (eng-infra): Ops note — for EU Gov we must ensure artifacts are stored in eu-west region and that presigned links TTL <= 7 days. I'll create a bucket policy template.
Mira (compliance): Also need data classification doc to attach. I'll draft and link to the presign package.
Toni (security): Can we run a short internal red-team pre-check before sending to vendor? If yes, I can allocate 1 day this week.
Elena (SI): That would help. If red-team ok, SI will sign attestation same day OEM confirms HSM details.
Sam (partnerships): Action items: 1) Toni: internal pre-check + vendor plan review (due Apr 20). 2) Mira: SOC2 extract + data classification (due Apr 22). 3) Raj: presign/bucket + policy (due Apr 24). 4) Elena: SI attestation template and OEM outreach (due Apr 22). I'll coordinate partner comms and confirm submission window (due Apr 28).
DeployBot: Reminder: workspace policy requires any PII in uploads be redacted or uploaded to secure vault. See https://redwood.internal/docs/evidence-upload
Toni (security): acked. I'll post redaction checklist in this thread after vendor plan lands. :thumbsup:
Sam (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short calendar for a sync on Apr 19 to review status.
Mira (compliance): On it, will add meeting notes template and the artifact checklist to the event invite.
Elena (SI): Thanks — will prep attestation draft and OEM email.
Sam (partnerships): Closing note: keep all uploads to `s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/` and tag artifacts with `acme-eu-gov` label so audits can find them.
